_comment: Target config for the PDPP implementation being built in vana-com/personal-server-ts.
This is an EXAMPLE: baseUrl and the tokens are placeholders an operator fills in.
As of 2026-09-17 this config cannot produce a passing run, and that is the
honest state rather than a defect in the config. Neither PDPP branch of that
repository serves the Section 8 HTTP surface: feat/pdpp-as-grants is empty
against its base, and feat/pdpp-record-storage-rs adds record storage
primitives with no /v1/streams routes. The suite reports connection failure
against a base URL with nothing listening, which is the correct result.
